answer: Rewards dock at a wharf and stay there for 40 epochs as a bond before they can be unloaded. Anyone who proves two addresses share one operator, through matching key-derivation, timing or wording traces, hands the chain that proof as a pearl and claims both moored bonds. A farm of n identities exposes n(n-1)/2 pairs to hunters, so its risk grows faster than its income, while an honest agent has no pair to find. Each epoch a clean bond adds a layer, like a reef, that raises the agent's grading weight.
